comment: The sixteen step levels are drawn in the display when the step sequencer shape is chosen and carry no panel position of their own; they are tagged to the line about a step's height. A gate input is read twice over: a rising edge through 1V starts the envelope, and the level is also read as a gate that is high above 2V. The three wave outputs swing plus or minus 5V for a bipolar shape and 0-10V for a unipolar one, so their range follows the shape rather than the jack. The clock input is read as a trigger, high above 1V, with Clock in QuarterNotes chosen on the menu; with Clock in BPM CV chosen the voltage sets the tempo instead, doubling it per volt.
